heading: Experience
subheading: Internships where I worked on charging software and the services behind it.

entries.description: Worked on KaroCharge, an EV charging platform. Built and extended the Spring Boot API around OCPP 2.0.1 charging sessions, integrating CitrineOS as the CSMS, Hasura GraphQL, and deployment on AWS EC2 behind Nginx.

Worked on EV-SIM, a full-stack OCPP 2.0.1 simulation platform. Implemented the FastAPI backend and a Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind interface, including OpenAI API integration so chargers could be controlled in natural language.
